question: Padma Shri 2022 awardee Vandana Kataria plays which of the following sports?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hockey**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Vandana Kataria is an Indian field hockey player who was awarded the Padma Shri in 2022
 
• Some of her notable accomplishments include:
 
• In the 2013 Women's Hockey Junior World Cup, India won a bronze medal, and Kataria was the top goal-scorer with five goals.
 
• During the 2014 Asian Games, she was part of the Indian team that secured a bronze medal.
 
• Kataria represented India at the 2016 Rio Olympics.
 
• In the 2020 Tokyo Olympics, she made history as the first Indian woman to score a hat-trick at the Olympics, helping India defeat South Africa 4-3 in a pool A match.
 
• Kataria also became the first Indian woman to play in 300 international matches.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** The Padma Shri is India's fourth-highest civilian award, given to recognize distinguished service in any field. The awards are announced on Republic Day and presented by the President of India at a ceremony in Rashtrapati Bhavan
